dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body point toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no distinct asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with high median pixel intensity; uniform across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint linear scratches and small white circular spots visible on the dorsal surface, primarily localized to the left of the midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible longitudinal dorsal ridge, but no significant traumatic indentations or shadow-casting deformations present.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of fine, superficial linear marks and scratches across the dorsal plane.
